data.title: Serenity Mansion
data.about:
Welcome to the epitome of architectural brilliance and luxurious living at Serenity Mansions, nestled within the prestigious enclave of Tilal Al Ghaf. 

This awe-inspiring residential development, brought to you by the renowned Majid Al Futtaim, presents an unmatched collection of exquisitely designed 6 and 7-bedroom mansions, epitomizing the relentless pursuit of luxury and sophistication. Envisioned by internationally acclaimed designer firms, the three iconic design styles—Luna, Ayla, and Ara—gracefully adorn these mansions, creating a visual masterpiece. Set against the backdrop of picturesque lagoons and pristine white sandy beaches, this exclusive edition of residences unveils an enchanting ambience that exudes luxury and tranquillity.

Situated in the heart of Tilal Al Ghaf, one of Dubai’s most coveted communities, Serenity Mansions enjoys a prime location that seamlessly connects residents to central business districts, esteemed educational institutions, and an array of recreational hubs. The ease of accessibility to key destinations ensures a lifestyle of convenience and unlimited opportunities.

characteristics_module.title: Prime location in Tilal Al Ghaf community
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Modern & Spacious 6 & 7 bedroom mansions.
  • Prime location in Tilal Al Ghaf community.
  • Interior Design by Nabil Gholam, Blink, and Desert INK.
  • Access to world class amenities
  • A private pool and private lagoon available.
  • White sandy beach available to residents only.

location_tile.title: Welcome to a place that combines the finest of both worlds.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Indulge in an extraordinary lifestyle at Serenity Mansions, strategically nestled in the highly sought-after locale of Tilal Al Ghaf. This exclusive address presents a gateway to a world of unparalleled luxury, offering residents access to pristine beaches, captivating waterfront attractions, and a vibrant community that seamlessly blends the allure of nature, leisure, and urban living. Prepare to be captivated by the natural beauty surrounding you as sandy beach areas beckon you to unwind and bask in the sun’s warm embrace. Immerse yourself in a stroll along the shores, where leisure retail outlets await a treasure trove of enticing experiences. 

Beyond the boundaries of Serenity Mansions, you’ll find a seamless connectivity that paves the way for effortless exploration. Major highways effortlessly connect you to your chosen destinations, ensuring convenient access to the city’s vibrant heart and beyond. Within this vibrant community, nature takes centre stage, offering a tranquil escape from the hustle and bustle of urban life.

  • 10 Minutes – City Centre Me’aisem
  • 15 Minutes – Mall of the Emirates
  • 20 Minutes – Downtown Dubai
  • 25 Minutes – Al Maktoum International Airport
  • 30 Minutes – Dubai International Airport

seo.metaDescription: Serenity Mansion by Majid Al Futtaim presents luxurious 6-7 BR mansions by lagoons with white sandy beaches, designed by top firms for elegance.
